manage.onlyYou: Only you have access so far.

readonlyLoadError.headline: Could not open this diagram.

publicShareLoadError.body: The share link may have expired, been revoked, or the diagram may no longer exist.

saveError.headline: Couldn't save.
saveError.body: Your changes weren't saved. Browser storage may be full. Try clearing space and saving again.

importError.headline: Couldn't import.
importError.body: This file isn't a valid Axoview diagram. Make sure it's a .json or .zip exported from Axoview.

shareError.headline: Couldn't create share link.

migrate.title: Move session diagrams to Google Drive?
migrate.body: These diagrams live only in this browser tab and are lost when it closes:
migrate.destinationNote: They will move into your Drive folder, keeping their folders.
migrate.partialToast: {{moved}} moved, {{failed}} failed — the failed diagrams stayed in this session

driveRoot.title: Choose your Google Drive folder
driveRoot.body: Axoview keeps your diagrams in one folder in your Google Drive. It can only see the files it creates there — nothing else in your Drive.

driveAccess.title: Google Drive access is required
driveAccess.body: Axoview signs you in only to store your diagrams in your own Google Drive. Without the Drive permission there is nothing to sign in for — every save and open would fail.
driveAccess.instruction: Please continue and tick the checkbox that lets Axoview "see, edit, create and delete only the specific files you use with it."

driveDisplay.headline: This diagram lives in its owner's Google Drive
driveDisplay.signInBody: Sign in with Google so Axoview can check whether this diagram has been shared with you.
driveDisplay.grantBody: You are signed in, but Axoview needs your permission to open this specific file from Google Drive.
driveDisplay.grantUnavailable: Your Google account does not have access to this diagram through Axoview. If the diagram was shared with a different account, switch to it below. Otherwise ask the owner to share the file with you in Google Drive, then reload this page.
driveDisplay.grantUnavailableAs: You're signed in as {{email}}, which can't open this diagram. If it was shared with a different account, switch to it below. Otherwise ask the owner to share the file with you in Google Drive, then reload this page.
driveDisplay.pickerError: Could not open the Google Drive access dialog. This can happen when third-party cookies or pop-ups are blocked — allow them for this site, then try again.
driveDisplay.transientBody: We couldn't reach Google Drive to load this diagram. Check your connection and try again.
